raw_pages_text.text:
Riverside Medical Center - Neurology Clinic
100 Medical Plaza, Suite 400 | Encounter Date: 10/05/2026
PATIENT INFORMATION & DEMOGRAPHICS
Patient Name: Jane Doe | DOB: 01/15/1980 (Age: 38) | Sex: M
Procedure Requested: CT Scan of Head with Contrast (CPT 70460)
CHIEF COMPLAINT & HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient presents with persistent severe headaches, dizziness, and intermittent visual disturbances persisting for 3
months. Headaches are throbbing and atypical in nature.

PRIOR MANAGEMENT & CONSERVATIVE THERAPY
Trial of conservative treatment over past 8 weeks without improvement. Patient has tried oral NSAIDs and lifestyle
modifications without symptomatic resolution.
PHYSICAL & NEUROLOGICAL EXAMINATION
Neurological examination abnormal: focal asymmetry and mild ataxia. Cranial nerves II-XII evaluated. Motor testing
reveals mild left-sided pronator drift.

CLINICAL IMPRESSION & ASSESSMENT
Atypical chronic cephalalgia with focal neurological findings. Rule out intracranial pathology or space-occupying lesion.
PLAN & ORDERS
Ordered: CT Scan of Head with Contrast (CPT 70460). Contrast clinically indicated for further diagnostic evaluation of
intracranial pathology. Patient reports no known drug allergies and no contrast anaphylaxis.
